Identity.History: Tyrant of Syracuse from 405 to 367 BC. Dionysius I fortified Ortygia, built the Euryalus fortress and the great walls of Epipolae, fought four wars against Carthage and made Syracuse the most powerful Greek city of the West.
Identity.Tooltip: Traits: Medium Speed, Heavy Armor, Strong Attack, Shield Wall. Strong Against: All Cavalry (1.25x), Spartans (1.25x) Weak Against: Ranged Units, Sword Infantry.
